findings.summary: Each sample was measured by a separate runtime process.
Prepared and file-backed sync iterable byte batches isolate async source overhead while keeping the same public event-object checksum contract.

The same full-string checksum contract is compared across direct ReadableStream, async Iterable<Uint8Array[]>, prepared sync Iterable<Uint8Array[]>, and file-backed sync Iterable<Uint8Array[]> source shapes.
